subject: GPU entitlement & overflow plan for Lighthouse AI / SunPulse — urgent prioritization
messages:
From: James Carter <james.carter@lighthouse.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@lighthouse.ai; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Dedicated slots for Lighthouse — escalation request

Rachel —

Thanks again for the call this morning. To reiterate: Lighthouse is ready to finalize a Dedicated capacity contract that needs 64 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west for a Q3 performance ramp. This is driven by a go-live commitment we gave a marquee customer. We queued procurement last week and signed the MSA conditional on capacity availability.

Our infra team (ops@lighthouse.ai) has flagged that without firm reserved capacity we have to delay the launch by 6–8 weeks. We understand Redwood's overall shortages; that said, Lighthouse is a strategic enterprise customer and the deal size is material. Can you confirm whether Redwood can (a) reserve the 64 GPUs starting 2028-07-01 and (b) provide a short-term overflow option if physical nodes are still provisioning?

If you prefer, we can provide a brief exec note from our COO to prioritize. 

—James
Senior Infrastructure Lead
Lighthouse AI

Attachment: none
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: James Carter <james.carter@lighthouse.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Dedicated slots for Lighthouse — escalation request

James — thanks for the clear ask and context. I'm escalating internally now. Short note on constraints: our us-west Dedicated pool is committed across several reserved deals (including a recently ramped SunPulse commitment). We have a limited set of chassis arriving in June; provisioning timing is tight.

Immediate next steps from Redwood: (1) I will pull current committed vs. physical inventory and provide a day-by-day provisioning ETA by EOD tomorrow; (2) Ben, Karthik and I will draft a prioritized entitlement approach that balances contractual commitments vs. high-ARR strategic deals; (3) we will propose a temporary overflow plan (burst-to-hosted + preemptible fallback) if physical nodes arrive late.

Can you confirm the absolute earliest date Lighthouse can accept a staged handoff (e.g., 32 GPUs on 2028-07-01, remainder by 2028-07-15)? That helps the routing model.

—Rachel
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: proposal draft — entitlement index + overflow windows

Team —

Draft proposal to resolve contention between Lighthouse (enterprise, high ARR, legal signed) and SunPulse (committed reserve, signed PO attached):

1) Entitlement index: score deals by (a) contractual reserved GPUs, (b) ARR runway (next 12 months), (c) go-live customer SLAs. Use weights 0.5/0.3/0.2 respectively. Lighthouse scores highest in preliminary calc.

2) Staged fulfillment: allow Lighthouse a 50% staged start (32 GPUs) on 2028-07-01. Remaining 32 GPUs subject to confirmation when physical racks are in our provisioning window (target 2028-07-12 to 2028-07-18).

3) Overflow plan: offer SunPulse a temporary burst to hosted (managed but higher per-token cost) for up to 4 weeks while Lighthouse consumes initial capacity; in turn provide SunPulse an operational credit if they accept a staggered start.

4) Preemption guardrails: set strict SLOs so preemption only applies during off-peak hours (02:00–06:00 PT) unless otherwise agreed; no data plane disruption — only allocation slots for batch inference.

5) Exec notification & credits: Legal & Finance to confirm crediting language for SunPulse and contract amendment path.

Attaching: SunPulse PO reference (sunpulse-po-0428.pdf) and a working MOP for Lighthouse entitlement (lighthouse-entitlement-mop-v2.pdf).

Ben
Head of Customer Success Operations

Attachments: lighthouse-entitlement-mop-v2.pdf; sunpulse-po-0428.pdf
From: Eva Morales <eva.morales@sunpulse.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sunpulse.com; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Dedicated slots for Lighthouse — escalation request

Rachel — appreciate the heads-up. SunPulse has a signed PO for 32 reserved GPUs (PO attached to Ben's mail). We committed that capacity for a product release slated for late July. Moving to hosted temporarily would increase our unit costs materially and complicate our budgets.

We're open to a short-term accommodation, but we need concrete compensation (credit or price adjustment) and a guaranteed go-forward date for dedicated activation. If Redwood finalizes a staged approach, please include explicit credit amounts and the activation calendar.

—Eva
Head of Procurement, SunPulse

Attachment: none (PO already shared)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: proposal draft — entitlement index + overflow windows

Team —

I ran the entitlement calc against current ledger and live inventory. Summary: Lighthouse index = 0.79, SunPulse index = 0.61 (threshold for priority actions >0.7). Based on chassis ETAs and provisioning pipeline, the conservative plan that minimizes SLA risk is:

• Commit 32 GPUs to Lighthouse on 2028-07-01 (staged).
• Reserve remaining 32 GPUs for Lighthouse but only convert to active after physical rack acceptance (target window 2028-07-12 to 2028-07-18).
• Offer SunPulse a hosted-burst solution (cost uplift + 25%) with a credit of one week of service for inconvenience (credit to apply at invoice as line-item).
• If racks arrive late beyond 2028-07-18, automatic fallback: Redwood will swap in equivalent-latency capacity from our dedicated pool in another region (cross-region traffic permitted after approval) and provide a connectivity playbook.

I'll draft the exact contract amendment language for Ben & Legal to review. We should also prepare a short executive note for Lighthouse confirming the staged activation and for SunPulse noting the credit compensation.

Karthik
VP, Dedicated Capacity Delivery
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: James Carter <james.carter@lighthouse.ai>, Eva Morales <eva.morales@sunpulse.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU entitlement & overflow plan for Lighthouse AI / SunPulse — urgent prioritization

Thanks all — alignment summary below (finalizing thread so Legal/Finance can prepare amendments):

1) Staged reservation for Lighthouse (RD-DL-2028-1379): 32 GPUs active 2028-07-01, remaining 32 to be activated upon rack acceptance (target 2028-07-12–07-18).

2) SunPulse mitigation: immediate hosted-burst offer for up to 4 weeks at +25% unit cost and a one-week invoice credit applied as a line item if they accept. If SunPulse declines, we will hold their 32-reserved slots but may apply limited preemption during off-peak hours per guardrails.

3) Preemption & Data Safety: no data-plane eviction, only compute slot preemption; all preemptions will be logged and surfaced in the Console and compensated per the credit policy.

4) Exec communication: Ben will send a customer note to SunPulse with the credit terms. I will send Lighthouse the staged activation confirmation and the MOP attachment. Ops teams please review the cross-region fallback plan and confirm latency impacts by EOD Monday.

James, Eva — please acknowledge in this thread so we have written acceptance of the operational terms.

—Rachel
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: lighthouse-entitlement-mop-v2.pdf (for Lighthouse); sunpulse-po-0428.pdf (reference)
